properties.name: spring.ai.watsonx.ai.text-extraction.options.output-formats
properties.description: Output formats to extract. Use requested-outputs instead.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by requested-outputs, which matches the parameter name of the Text Extraction API.

properties.name: spring.ai.watsonx.ai.text-extraction.options.enable-ocr
properties.description: Whether OCR is enabled. Use ocr-mode instead.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by ocr-mode, where true maps to 'enabled' and false to 'disabled'.

properties.name: spring.ai.watsonx.ai.text-extraction.options.model
properties.description: Model for text extraction. Not sent to watsonx.ai.

deprecation.reason: The watsonx.ai Text Extraction API has no model parameter, so this value is not sent.
